description_en: Creates a task for the industry edition
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs add-task --task-type 1 --name '任务名称' --api-version 2023-05-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddTask

parameters.help_en:
The task type. Valid values:
1: Batch AI outbound call without transfer to human agent.
2: Batch voice notification.
6: New voice notification (the default voice notification type for enterprises that registered after October 2022)
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型  1:批量-AI外呼-不转人工，2:批量-语音通知，6：新语音通知（22年10月后入驻的企业的默认语音通知类型）
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The task name
parameters.help_zh: 任务名称
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The task start date
parameters.help_zh: 任务启动日期
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The script templatetype. Valid values:
1: single template.
2: intelligent script Policy Template.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 话术模板类型 ： 1: 单模 版；2：智能话术策略模板。不填默认1
parameters.name: template_type

parameters.help_en: The script template ID
parameters.help_zh: 话术模板ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The number of concurrent calls. Default value: 1. The value cannot exceed the maximum concurrency configured for the enterprise
parameters.help_zh: 并发数 默认为1，不可超过企业设置最高并发数
parameters.name: max_concurrency

parameters.help_en:
The recall configuration. Valid values:
1: no recall.
2: interval-based recall.
3: scheduled recall.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 重呼配置 可选值：1，2，3，默认为1； 1：不重呼；2：间隔重呼；3：定时重呼
parameters.name: recall_type

parameters.help_en: The recall interval. This parameter is required when RecallType is set to 2. Unit: minutes. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 重呼间隔 当重呼选项为2时，必填；单位为分钟，支持≥1的正整数
parameters.name: repeat_interval

parameters.help_en: The number of recall attempts. This parameter is required when RecallType is set to 2. The value must be a positive integer greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 重呼次数 当重呼选项为2时，必填；支持≥1正整数
parameters.name: repeat_count

parameters.help_en: The recall times
parameters.help_zh: 重呼时间
parameters.name: repeat_times

parameters.help_en: The recording URL. This parameter is required when the business type enabled for the enterprise is voice notification
parameters.help_zh: 录音地址 当企业开通业务类型是语音通知时，必填
parameters.name: record_path

parameters.help_en: The playback interval. This parameter is required when the business type enabled for the enterprise is voice notification. Unit: seconds. The value must be a non-negative integer
parameters.help_zh: 播放间隔时长 当企业开通业务类型是语音通知时，必填；单位为秒，支持输入≥0的正整数
parameters.name: play_sleep_val

parameters.help_en: The number of times the recording is played. This parameter is required when the business type enabled for the enterprise is voice notification. The value must be a non-negative integer
parameters.help_zh: 录音播放次数 当企业开通业务类型是语音通知时，必填；支持输入≥0的正整数
parameters.name: play_times

parameters.help_en: The recall conditions
parameters.help_zh: 重呼条件
parameters.name: repeat_reason

parameters.help_en: The call time. Format example: "8:30-12:00 13:30-19:00" is passed as [[8.5,12][13.5,19]]. Default value: [[8,20]]
parameters.name: call_time_list

parameters.help_en: The SMS sending rule
parameters.help_zh: 短信发送规则
parameters.name: send_sms_plan

parameters.help_en: The callback URL
parameters.help_zh: 回调地址
parameters.name: callback_url

parameters.help_en: The flash SMS configuration
parameters.help_zh: 发送闪信配置
parameters.name: flash_sms_type

parameters.help_en: The flash SMS template ID. This parameter is required when the flash SMS configuration is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 当发送闪信配置为1时，闪信模板ID必填
parameters.name: flash_sms_template_id

fields.help_zh: 第一个调用时间字符串
fields.name: call_time

parameters.help_en: The call time accurate to minutes. If both this parameter and CallTimeList have values, this parameter takes precedence. Use this parameter for minute-level precision. Example: 08:31-12:05 13:33-19:00 is passed as [["08:31","12:05"]["13:33","19:00"]]. Default value: [["08:00","20:00"]]
parameters.name: call_time_str_list

parameters.help_en: The days of the week for outbound calls. Example: [1,2,3,4,5,6,7] indicates calls are made from Monday to Sunday
parameters.help_zh: 外呼时间需要的按星期几进行外呼，例：[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]，代表周一到周日都外呼
parameters.name: week_tag

true: Successful.
false: Failed
